name: DWH Relation Model

semantics.id: stable entity identity within the applicable canonical DWH context

semantics.order: deterministic ordering value for ordered projections

rules: relation authority is not duplicated inside entity data
missing or ambiguous required relation targets fail visibly
ordering changes projection order, not entity identity
projection does not create a new canonical entity
containment, ownership, authority, dependency and causality must not be inferred from visual placement
a resolved reference does not by itself prove semantic compatibility or authorization
